ucs.title: [LLM] MuddyWater (Mango Sandstorm / MERCURY / TA450) RMM-installer chain — phish click → msiexec installs ScreenConnect/Atera/RemoteUtilities from
ucs.description: Catches MuddyWater's signature initial-access + persistence pattern: a spearphish lure (PDF/HTML/OneNote with embedded link, sometimes through a compromised partner per T1199) drops a ZIP to the user's Downloads/Temp folder, the user runs an MSI, and msiexec silently installs a legitimate RMM agent (ConnectWise ScreenConnect, Atera, RemoteUtilities, Syncro) which the operator then uses for hands-on-keyboard access. Microsoft (Mango Sandstorm), Proofpoint (TA450) and CISA AA22-055A have repeatedly documented this exact chain — the use of signed, commercially licensed RMM rather than custom malw
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as command_line values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_command values(Processes.parent_process_path) as parent_path from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name=msiexec.exe (Processes.process="*ScreenConnect*" OR Processes.process="*ConnectWiseControl*" OR Processes.process="*atera*" OR Processes.process="*AteraAgent*" OR Processes.process="*remoteutilities*" OR Processes.process="*rutserv*" OR Processes.process="*syncromsp*" OR Processes.process="*Syncro*") by host Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.dest | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where match(parent_path, "(?i)\\\\(Downloads|Temp|Roaming|Public|ProgramData)\\\\") OR match(command_line, "(?i)\\\\(Downloads|Temp|Roaming|Public|ProgramData)\\\\[^\\\\]+\\.msi") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let WindowMin = 60m;
let RmmAgents = dynamic(["screenconnect","connectwisecontrol","atera","ateraagent","remoteutilities","rutserv","syncromsp","syncro","anydesk","splashtop"]);
let UserFolderRe = @"(?i)\\(Downloads|Temp|Roaming|Public|ProgramData)\\";
let Clicks = UrlClickEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("ClickAllowed","ClickedThrough")
    | where Url matches regex @"(?i)\.(zip|rar|7z|html|pdf|one|img|iso)(\?|$)"
    | project ClickTimestamp = Timestamp, AccountUpn, Url;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where FileName =~ "msiexec.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (RmmAgents)
   or (ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)/(i|package)\s+" and ProcessCommandLine matches regex UserFolderRe)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| join kind=inner Clicks on $left.AccountUpn == $right.AccountUpn
| where Timestamp between (ClickTimestamp .. ClickTimestamp + WindowMin)
| extend DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', Timestamp, ClickTimestamp)
| project ClickTimestamp, InstallTimestamp = Timestamp, DelayMin, DeviceName, AccountUpn, Url, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| order by InstallTimestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let RmmAgents = dynamic(["screenconnect","connectwisecontrol","atera","ateraagent","remoteutilities","rutserv","syncromsp","syncro","anydesk","splashtop"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName endswith "\\msiexec.exe"
| where CommandLine has_any (RmmAgents)
| where (ParentProcessName matches regex @"(?i)\\(Downloads|Temp|Roaming|Public|ProgramData)\\"
      or CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\\(Downloads|Temp|Roaming|Public|ProgramData)\\[^\\]+\.msi")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account = SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, TokenElevationType
| order by TimeGenerated desc

author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/29

logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_msi:
    Image|endswith: '\msiexec.exe'
  selection_rmm:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'ScreenConnect'
      - 'ConnectWiseControl'
      - 'AteraAgent'
      - 'atera_agent'
      - 'remoteutilities'
      - 'rutserv'
      - 'syncromsp'
      - 'Syncro.Installer'
  selection_path:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '\Downloads\'
      - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
      - '\AppData\Roaming\'
      - '\Users\Public\'
      - '\ProgramData\'

    User|endswith: '$'

falsepositives:

level: high

#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\msiexec\.exe$/i
| CommandLine=/(screenconnect|connectwisecontrol|ateraagent|atera_agent|remoteutilities|rutserv|syncromsp|syncro\.installer)/i
| CommandLine=/\\(Downloads|Temp|Roaming|Public|ProgramData)\\/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
| _count >= 1

ucs.title: [LLM] MuddyWater POWGOOP loader — malicious goopdate.dll sideloaded by signed GoogleUpdate.exe spawning PowerShell
ucs.description: Hunts MuddyWater's POWGOOP custom loader, which the actor pairs with their POWERSTATS PowerShell backdoor (Microsoft / Mango Sandstorm; Palo Alto Unit 42). The chain drops a legitimately-signed GoogleUpdate.exe (or GoogleUpdateSetup.exe) alongside a trojanised goopdate.dll plus encrypted goopdate.dat config into a non-Google path; the signed binary sideloads the malicious DLL (T1574.002) which decodes goopdate.dat and launches obfuscated PowerShell (T1059.001 / T1027.010). Detecting GoogleUpdate.exe parenting powershell/cmd/rundll32 from outside Program Files\Google is the cleanest single-even
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as command_line values(Processes.parent_process_path) as parent_path values(Processes.process_path) as process_path from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name=GoogleUpdate.exe OR Processes.parent_process_name=GoogleUpdateSetup.exe) (Processes.process_name=powershell.exe OR Processes.process_name=pwsh.exe OR Processes.process_name=rundll32.exe OR Processes.process_name=cmd.exe OR Processes.process_name=wscript.exe) by host Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.dest | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where NOT match(parent_path, "(?i)\\\\Program Files( \\(x86\\))?\\\\Google\\\\") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 30d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName endswith "\\GoogleUpdate.exe" or ParentProcessName endswith "\\GoogleUpdateSetup.exe"
| where NewProcessName has_any ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","rundll32.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe")
| extend ParentLower = tolower(ParentProcessName)
| where not(ParentLower contains @"\program files\google\")
      and not(ParentLower contains @"\program files (x86)\google\")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account = SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, TokenElevationType
| order by TimeGenerated desc
